title: ExFold: Unified Expert Folding for Training-Free MoE Prefill-Decode Acceleration
abstract: arXiv:2608.24938v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity for strong quality while keeping per-token compute bounded through sparse expert activation. Yet low-latency MoE serving is increasingly challenging, because it spans two inference phases with fundamentally different bottlenecks: prefill is dominated by token-wise expert computation, whereas decode is constrained by memory traffic from the batch-wise activated expert set. However, existing training-free acceleration methods optimize only a single resource proxy, either the experts each token executes or the experts a batch activates, and either discard the excluded experts' contribution or leave it only implicitly approximated. In this paper, we propose ExFold, a unified training-free expert-folding framework for jointly accelerating MoE prefill and decode. ExFold casts both prefill and decode as one budgeted output-approximation problem: execute only a phase-specific constrained expert set

translated_title: ExFold：统一专家折叠技术，实现免训练的MoE预填充与解码加速
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24938v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：混合专家（MoE）模型通过稀疏专家激活扩展容量以保持高质量，同时限制每令牌计算量。然而，低延迟的MoE服务日益具有挑战性，因为它跨越两个根本瓶颈不同的推理阶段：预填充阶段受令牌级专家计算主导，而解码阶段则受批次激活专家集的记忆流量限制。现有免训练加速方法仅优化单一资源代理，要么优化每个令牌执行的专家，要么优化批次激活的专家，且要么丢弃被排除专家的贡献，要么仅隐含近似其影响。本文提出ExFold，一个统一的免训练专家折叠框架，用于联合加速MoE预填充和解码。ExFold将预填充和解码视为一个有预算的输出近似问题：仅执行阶段特定的受限专家集。
tldr: ExFold提出了一种统一的免训练专家折叠框架，通过将预填充和解码统一为预算输出近似问题，同时优化两个阶段的专家选择，从而加速MoE推理。
en_tdlr: ExFold proposes a unified training-free expert-folding framework that accelerates MoE inference by casting both prefill and decode as a budgeted output-approximation problem, jointly optimizing expert selection across phases.
